summary: Implemented PSI-104. finance/actions.ts: getBoardFinanceSummaryAction(boardId) + getEventFinanceSummaryAction(eventId), gated requirePermission('finance.read'), aggregate finance_entries to inflow/outflow/net/entryCount + per-category totals (name/slug/color/direction via finance_categories), decimal strings via formatAmount. New BoardFinancePanel: inflow/outflow/net cards, per-category list, 'Add entry' (EntryFormDialog prefilled boardId, canWrite), 'View full ledger'->/dashboard/finance. EntryFormDialog gained initialBoardId/initialTaskId; taskId flows into entrySchema->createEntryAction. KanbanViewPage renders Base UI Tabs Tasks|Finance when canReadFinance; otherwise plain board. Permissions flow from server pages (kanban/page.tsx, calendar/page.tsx) via session. TaskCard gained dnd-safe TaskFinanceButton (stops pointerdown; drag handle intact) prefilled board+task; canWriteFinance threaded KanbanBoard->TaskColumn->TaskCard. Calendar event dialog shows finance block (finance.read only): entry count, In/Out/Net via formatIDR, 'View ledger' link; fetch via getEventFinanceSummaryAction with cancellation guard. Non-finance readers see no amounts: UI gates + DB RLS (can_read_finance/can_write_finance, activity_log finance rule from M10). Reused existing formatIDR/formatDateWIB and EntryFormDialog; did not follow finance.md stale 'Sheet' wording.

decisions.decision: Summary computed in the server action (fetch rows + aggregate in JS) rather than a SQL RPC
decisions.reason: PSI-103 shipped no summary RPC; client needs no new endpoint and RLS already filters rows, keeping the arithmetic identical for every caller. Caters to board sizes without premature aggregation in postgres.

decisions.decision: Amounts stay decimal strings end to end; formatAmount() rounds via numeric string, not float addition
decisions.reason: Matches m10-finance.md's 'decimal string, never a float on the wire' rule (finance_entries.amount numeric(16,2)).

decisions.decision: Permission gates: UI hides the tab/button, AND the action re-checks requirePermission('finance.read'/'finance.write') server-side
decisions.reason: Defense in depth; the DB RLS (can_read_finance/can_write_finance) is the final authority, so the UI gate is a UX courtesy not a security boundary.

decisions.decision: TaskFinanceButton stops pointerdown + click propagation so the dnd-kit card drag handle does not start a drag
decisions.reason: TaskCard is a draggable handle (asHandle); an unguarded button would break drag-and-drop restore.

decisions.decision: Reused EntryFormDialog with initialBoardId/initialTaskId instead of building a second task-scoped form
decisions.reason: One dialog, one schema, one submit path; prefill is a prop not a fork.
